execution_plan.role: Senior Skyrim modding expert. Apply patches in implementation_order. Compile after Papyrus changes. Do not report compile errors or case mismatches. GetFormFromFile is intentional. DOM handler is optional (Interface stub or SkyrimNet_SexLab_Handler_DOM.esp).
execution_plan.architecture: GetAnim_Info rebuilds a fresh JMap each call (animation and stage can change between calls), so caching is not viable; callers must release the retained return. Scene tracks victim-faction grants in a retained JArray of forms (not a parallel Actor[]) so departed actors can still be cleared. Main.Setup owns DOM handler wiring; Handler_DOM_PR player-alias is an intentional no-op.

step.summary: Retain anim_info in GetAnim_Info; release in all 5 callers.
Track victim-faction grants in retained JArray; ReconcileVictimFactions in Setup/AlignActors; clear in Release.
Remove dead commented handler.Setup(); document Main.Setup as owner.
Map furniture tags to natural preposition-led phrases in GetLocation.

step.action: Compile Scripts/Source via compile: pyro task — zero errors expected (done: exit 0, scripts already up to date)

finding.problem: GetAnim_Info builds a fresh JMap.object() every call and returned it un-retained; callers never freed it. Animation and stage can both change between calls, so caching is not viable — this was JContainers churn on every stage tick.
finding.fix: JValue.retain(anim_info) before return; JValue.release(anim_info) in GetStageDescription, GetOrgasmExpected, SetOrgasmExpected, GetHasDescriptionOrgasmExpected, and EditDescriptions once values are read. Do not release per-file info objects (children re-parented into anim_info).

finding.problem: EditDescriptions showed the "You may enter a description..." help whenever desc == "", ignoring stages.hide_help. MCM SexEditHelpToggle was wired but had no effect.
finding.fix: Gate help/example behind if !hide_help; when hidden show minimal "Stage N: (no description)" line.

finding.problem: Setup added SkyrimNet_SexLab_Faction_Victim to current victims; Release cleared it only for current thread.positions; AlignActors did not clean actors who left mid-scene, so departed victims kept the faction.
finding.fix: Track grants in retained JArray victim_faction_forms (not a parallel Actor[]). ReconcileVictimFactions() adds/removes/drops departed; call from Setup and AlignActors; Release clears every tracked form then JArray.clear.

finding.problem: Trace function-name labels did not match enclosing functions (CreateSceneByThread vs CreateSceneWithoutCreator; OrgasmCombined vs OrgasmIndividual; Start vs StartScene; SexVictims vs SetVictims), making log filtering misleading.
finding.fix: Correct each Trace label/message to the actual function name. Also fix GetSceneByThread message "CreateSceneWithoutCreator returned None" -> "CreateSceneByCreator returned None".

finding.problem: OnPlayerLoadGame held a dead commented handler.Setup(). Harmless because Main.Setup owns DOM wiring, but the alias looked like a broken setup path.
finding.fix: Remove the commented call; document that the alias is an intentional no-op and Main.Setup owns DOM init. Keep the script/property for CK alias binding.

finding.problem: GetLocation furniture branch assigned the raw tag (e.g. "Table", "WoodenPony") with no article/preposition, so _location read as a bare noun in narration.
finding.fix: Parallel on_furniture_phrase[] with natural phrases (e.g. "on a table", "on a wooden pony", "in a cage"); set loc = on_furniture_phrase[i] when found.

not_a_bug.item: punish_* direction stays type: dynamic with value: giving|getting — intentionally NOT changed to description:. giving|getting decides speaker-vs-target victim role and must remain LLM-chosen. Do not re-report.
Manager OrgasmIndividual Dom early-return — SkyrimNet_DOM calls DOMSlave_Orgasmed externally.
